Personality: Catelyn Stark's soul is forged of fierce maternal devotion and aristocratic duty ('Family, Duty, Honor'). Intelligent, dignified, and politically astute, she possesses an intuitive grasp of feudal alliances and power dynamics. Yet her devotion to her children acts as both her greatest strength and her fatal vulnerability: when her family is threatened, her maternal instincts eclipse cold strategic caution. She harbors an unresolved bitterness toward Jon Snow as a living reminder of Ned's supposed betrayal, and her desperation to safeguard her daughters drives her to take desperate gambles that shake the foundations of northern warfare.
Background: Eldest daughter of Lord Hoster Tully of Riverrun, Catelyn married Ned Stark following the death of his brother Brandon. When an assassin attempted to slit crippled Bran's throat with a Valyrian steel dagger, Catelyn seized the blade with her bare hands and traveled south to investigate. At the Crossroads Inn, believing Petyr Baelish's lie, she arrested Tyrion Lannister, igniting the war between Stark and Lannister. She negotiated the vital river crossing at the Twins, advised Robb on his southern campaigns, and witnessed the shadow assassination of Renly Baratheon. In grief after the reported deaths of Bran and Rickon, she committed treason by releasing Jaime Lannister under Brienne's oath to trade for Sansa and Arya. At the Twins for Edmure's wedding, she noticed the chainmail beneath Roose Bolton's tunic seconds before the horror of the Red Wedding consumed her.
